setup_segments.basis: A single conservative pre-execution debit covers source editing, static checks, external source verification, config hashing, and preseed commits/pushes whose per-process CPU counters were not captured before the ledger existed. This is a budget charge, not a claim that exactly 300 CPU seconds were consumed.
setup_segments.label: preseed_source_editing_static_verification_and_config_lock_prepare_push
